## 04a27ff51304

**Finding A2 — reproduced three-demo teaching ambiguity.** Generator SHA-256
`d9e6c8d15eae0c2505749ea4eb92ca5b29036c416fc3c13a017e0eb9194d9101`.
For default band `None`, seed `0`, consecutive sample indices `0,1,2,3`, the
plausible rival “paint 8 wherever nonzero occupancy forms both a horizontal run
of length at least 3 and a vertical run of length at least 3, ignoring whether
the colors match” agrees with the authoritative Racket outputs on all three
demonstrations and differs on the query by one cell. All four inputs pass the
target's `self_check`.

This is directly relevant to the documented distinction between same-color
crosses and different-color decoy crosses. A three-demo/one-query lesson can
therefore leave the color-continuity requirement unidentified even though every
label is correct. The target declares no executable lesson competitor or
semantic witness to reject this window.

Reproducer and evidence:

- `checks/audit/04a27ff51304/input.json` — four consecutive generated inputs
- `checks/audit/04a27ff51304/racket.json` — authority outputs, rule hash
  `f3a3e1a37f60`
- `checks/audit/04a27ff51304/rival-output.json`
- `checks/audit/04a27ff51304/shortcut-repro.json` — exact search domain,
  sample identities, self-check results, and `[true,true,true,false]` authority
  agreement vector
- `checks/audit/04a27ff51304-battery/checks/04a27ff51304_audit_battery_summary.json`

The audit battery also failed 5/12 stages: lint, defect lint, profile floor,
semantic gate, and override. It reports a missing `RULE_HASH`, no semantic
contract, no easy-band canonical-profile hit in 20 draws, and difficulty-local
rejection of advertised exact dimensions. No source was changed.

Commands, from workspace root `WORK/`:

```bash
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 04a27ff51304 \
  --input ../checks/audit/04a27ff51304/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/04a27ff51304/racket.json
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles check 04a27ff51304 \
  --battery --compact-results --timeout 4000 --phase audit \
  --out ../checks/audit/04a27ff51304-battery
```
